version.changelog:
Initial release of WhiteMagic: local-first memory and session continuity for coding agents.

- Durable, on-device memory system keeps project context and records key decisions.
- Integrates with OpenClaw via MCP, supporting easy setup and session management.
- Supports recalling context, recording decisions, and checkpointing sessions.
- Optional read-only hosted recall service for quick access without local install.
- Emphasizes privacy: data stays local by default, no telemetry, and explicit memory management.

llm.summary: This skill is a clearly disclosed local memory helper for coding agents, with persistent storage and MCP setup that fit its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: Local storage, optional hosted read-only recall, and git-state checkpointing when WM_PROJECT_ROOT is set are proportionate for a session-continuity tool as disclosed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation requires a global npm package or native binary and can patch OpenClaw MCP configuration, but these steps are explicit and user-directed.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The working rules direct agents to search and update memory and record session checkpoints, but they also limit storage to decisions rather than transcripts and warn to treat recalled content as data, not instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill intentionally creates durable local memory and session records, which is persistent behavior, but it is the core advertised function and includes a warning not to store credentials or secrets.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact describes durable local memory, session continuity, recall, decision recording, and checkpoints; these capabilities are coherent with the skill name and description.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this adds persistent memory to your coding agent and may patch your OpenClaw MCP configuration. Use it only for project context and decisions, avoid storing secrets or credentials, and review the external whitemagic package or hosted OAuth option if you choose those setup paths.
